title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person leg's awaiting UPDATE is still unguarded on taken_over_at — the dedicated guarded SQL is never called and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235-1257: `case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(...) ... False -> case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(...) False -> case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated) {...` — update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24: `WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause). mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql:16 `AND taken_over_at IS NULL` has ZERO callers outside the generated sql.gleam:1891. Test 1743-1747: `// Take-over lands between the wrong-person read and the UPDATE. actions_handler.do_take_over(...) |> should.equal(200)` then `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` — calls the guarded SQL DIRECTLY, never the POST /reference/:token/wrong-person path the handler runs.
